source.book: 据《史记》卷一百一十九《循吏列传》改编。
source.excerpt: 楚民俗好庳車，王以爲庳車不便馬，欲下令使髙之。相曰：「令數下，民不知所從，不可。王必欲髙車，臣請教閭里使髙其梱。乘車者皆君子，君子不能數下車。」王許之。居半歳，民悉自髙其車。

Use case: illustration-story. Make ONE finished Histree vintage Chinese lianhuanhua atlas for《孙叔敖与高门槛》. EXACTLY 6 equal landscape illustrations, STRICT TWO columns × 3 rows. Read left to right, top to bottom. Target 1024×990. Straight thin cream gutters 6px, no outer margin/header/footer, no merged cells or insets. NO TEXT anywhere: no Chinese, letters, numerals, captions, labels, calligraphy, speech bubbles, watermarks. Documents must be blank.
The supplied image is ONLY a STYLE reference: match early Shanghai animation / classic 1950s Chinese small-picture books, expressive stylized ADULT folk-art people with angular eyebrows and noses, larger heads, compact adult bodies, spare fluid BLACK ink lines, FLAT matte indigo/ochre/cinnabar/green blocks, subtle paper grain and warm cream negative space. Simple geometric buildings and restrained landscapes. No realistic skin modeling, brocade detail, modern anime, 3D or glossy shading. Do NOT copy the reference's story, props, characters or lettering.
Character continuity and physical invariants: 孙叔敖青蓝袍，庄王赭红袍。门槛横在村门底部，低车无法方便通过，高车车身抬高；不画现代栏杆收费站。
Illustrate these events EXACTLY in order. The following Chinese describes scenes, NEVER render the text:
1. 楚地百姓习惯使用低矮的车。
2. 楚庄王觉得低车不便于马，想下令把车改高。

5. 乘车的人不愿频繁下车，便逐渐把自己的车改高。
6. 过了半年，百姓的车辆都改高了。
